name: Contact Point
definition: Number, physical or virtual address, used for communication.

BICAddress.name: BIC Address
BICAddress.definition: BIC address which identifies the contact point.

TemporaryIndicator.name: Temporary Indicator
TemporaryIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the address is a temporary address.

RelatedInvestmentFund.name: Related Investment Fund
RelatedInvestmentFund.definition: Investment fund class for which an order desk is specified.

RelatedParty.name: Related Party
RelatedParty.definition: Party for which a contact point is specified.

RelatedCorporateActionEvent.name: Related Corporate Action Event
RelatedCorporateActionEvent.definition: Corporate action event for which the documentation location is specified.

RelatedReportingService.name: Related Reporting Service
RelatedReportingService.definition: Reporting service for which a contact point is specified.

StoredDocument.name: Stored Document
StoredDocument.definition: Document which is stored at a specific place.

RemittanceRelatedPayment.name: Remittance Related Payment
RemittanceRelatedPayment.definition: Payment for which a remittance location is specified.

RelatedProxyAppointment.name: Related Proxy Appointment
RelatedProxyAppointment.definition: Proxy appointment process for which a notification address is specified.

ContactPointForMeeting.name: Contact Point For Meeting
ContactPointForMeeting.definition: Meeting which takes place at a specific place.

ContactPointForVote.name: Contact Point For Vote
ContactPointForVote.definition: Vote parameters which apply to a vote location.

MainContact.name: Main Contact
MainContact.definition: Contact address used for normal operations.

ReturnAddress.name: Return Address
ReturnAddress.definition: Physical/logical address, segregated from the main address that is used for normal operations. The return address is used to route messages that require specific attention/exception handling, eg, returns or rejects.

RelatedPayment.name: Related Payment
RelatedPayment.definition: Payment for which a notification method is specified.

DeliveredAttendanceCard.name: Delivered Attendance Card
DeliveredAttendanceCard.definition: Attendance card which is delivered at a specific location.

InvestmentFundClassProcessing.name: Investment Fund Class Processing
InvestmentFundClassProcessing.definition: Processing characteristics of an investment fund class for which a local market annex is specified.
